answer_1.quote: Given a cluster of documents related to the same topic or event, the task of multi-document summarization (MDS) centers on a brief summary of the cluster.
answer_1.outputs: extractive summaries consisting of sentences selected from the input document cluster

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE as the automatic metric, which has been observed in a good agreement with human judgment.

answer_4.quote: To further assess the linguistic quality of different summaries, we employ Amazon Mechanical Turk 9 workers to judge the performance of three summarizers on a random sample of Multi-News (200 document clusters).
answer_4.guideline: A worker is asked to rate each summary on a scale of 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent) according to three criteria: relevancy (the summary cover all the key information of document cluster?), non-redundancy and grammaticality.
